releaseNotes:
## Guest Inbox
- Create your own reply snippets: choose the button title and the message. There are no built-in snippets, and a deleted snippet stays deleted.

## Contacts
- Add, rename, and remove family members in one list on the family page and on each contact.
- The last adult can leave a family. Name-only members stay, and past bookings keep the saved name.
- Select several people and delete them together. Deleted contacts can be restored for 30 days.

## Weekly
- Cancelled conferences no longer show on the weekly meeting-room rows.

## Bookings
- A room can hold more overnight guests than it has beds when the extra people are children. Mark them as Child; a pack-and-play or mattress does not take a bed.
